items.name: Banana fibre (“banana silk”)
items.fact: In parts of Japan and Nepal, the stems of banana plants, usually thrown away after the harvest, are spun into a glossy, silk-like textile used for clothing and furniture.

items.name: Pineapple leather (Piñatex)
items.fact: A material made from the fibres of pineapple leaves that would otherwise be left to rot in the fields. Fashion brands use it for shoes, jackets and handbags.

items.name: Kombucha leather
items.fact: The rubbery jelly culture used to brew kombucha (a “SCOBY”) can be dried into a flexible, leathery sheet. Designers have made bags, caps and lampshades from it.

items.name: Bricks grown with human urine
items.fact: Researchers at the University of Cape Town grew “bio-bricks” from sand, bacteria and human urine. Unlike normal bricks, they set at room temperature instead of being fired in a kiln.

items.name: Fish-scale sequins
items.fact: A textile designer in London developed sequins and leather-like sheets from fish scales thrown away by the fishing industry, to replace plastic in fashion and interiors.

items.name: Algae-foam shoe soles
items.fact: Companies harvest algae from lakes choked by algae blooms, dry it and turn it into the foam used in flip-flops and trainer soles, cleaning the water at the same time.

items.name: Avocado-stone plastic
items.fact: A Mexican company makes biodegradable cutlery and straws from the stones of avocados thrown away by factories that make guacamole and avocado oil.

items.name: Rose fibre
items.fact: Fibre from the waste parts of rose plants is spun into a soft, shiny yarn sometimes sold as “vegan silk”, used for scarves and dresses.

items.name: Fabric dyed by bacteria
items.fact: Some bacteria naturally produce bright colours. Designers grow them on fabric so that the bacteria do the dyeing, with far less water and no toxic dye chemicals.

items.name: Cactus leather
items.fact: Leaves of the prickly pear cactus can be cut without killing the plant, which grows them back. They are turned into a tough vegan leather used for bags and car seats.
